newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek swap yield curve softer, ecu/drs above 304.
newsitem.headline: Greek swap yield curve softer, ecu/drs above 304.

text.p: Greek interbank depo rates were holding but implied drachma rates from forex forwards were softer across-the-board and ECU/drachma was glued in the 303.95/304.30 corridor in late calm dealing, traders said.

"Implied rates are slightly down with one-month and two-month rates lower than the others," said a money dealer at a foreign bank. "Perhaps it has to do with the expected speech of the central bank governor on monetary policy."
Bank of Greece Governor Lucas Papademos is expected to outline Greece's 1997 monetary policy on Friday or Monday.
"It (speech) is going to take place either tomorrow or Monday at the latest," a central bank official told Reuters.
The central bank kept its overnight bid unchanged at 12.40 percent.
Bond dealers said trading volume continued to be very thin over persisting uncertainty related to taxation issues of government securities.
"The market is very thin with very few deals taking place due to confusion over tax issues," a bond dealer said.
The finance ministry slashed T-bill rates by 20 basis points to 9.80 percent, 10.10 percent and 10.90 percent for three-, six- and 12-month T-bills effective January 30, it said in a statement.
Greece will auction 300 billion drachmas of 12-month T-bills on February 3 and issue two-year zero coupon bonds on December 31, the finance ministry said in a statement on Tuesday.
ECU/drachma was trading just above 304 after spending time in the 303.90/304.30 band.
"We had inflows in the morning which were offset by some outflows in the afternoon," a forex dealer said. "Nothing noteworthy happened at the fixing."
The mark was quoted at 156.87/97 drachmas from Thursday's 156.860 fix, the dollar at 257.92/02 drachmas from 257.090 and the ECU at 304.00/20 from 303.990 drachmas.
The National Bank of Greece, the domestic money market's biggest player, quoted the following late rates:
** Overnight at 11.90-12.40
** One week at 11.90-12.40
** Two weeks at 11.80-12.30
** Three weeks at 11.70-12.20
** One month at 11.60-12.10
** Two months at 11.55-12.05
** Three months at 11.40-11.90
** Six months at 11.20-11.70
** Nine months at 11.10-11.60
** Twelve months at 11.00-11.50
